title: BPW-2026-0473
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET SERVICES]
BPW-2026-0473
CD 14
TREE REMOVAL – 3880 EAST SAN RAFAEL AVENUE
Recommending the Board:
FIND that this project is categorically exempt under Section 15331, Class 31; Section 1533232, Class 32; and there is no substantial evidence the proposed project will have significant effect on the environment and is in compliance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA);
FIND that none of the exceptions to the use of categorical exemption as set forth in Sections 15300.2 of State CEQA Guidelines apply;
SPECIFY that the Bureau of Street Services, Urban Forestry Division, located at 1149 South Broadway, is custodian of the documents or other material that constitute the record of proceedings upon which the Board’s decision is based; and
REVIEW and APPROVE the request for a fee permit to remove ten protected trees/shrubs. Tree replacements are required.
summary: Approval to remove protected trees at 3880 EAST SAN RAFAEL AVENUE, Los Angeles, CA.
